classificationReason: Creator attended the first preview of The Great Gatsby at Paper Mill Playhouse (a pre-Broadway regional tryout) and shares first-hand opinions about the songs, cast (Jeremy Jordan, Sam Polly, Ivana Bouzata), and their experience. This appears to be the same production that transferred to Broadway; matched to the-great-gatsby-2024. Confidence medium because it's the regional tryout, not the Broadway run itself.
